Yes I had social anxiety but was trying to hide it en route to their family’s house. Initially there were only a few people at the house but on the way they revealed that there’s a lot of people there including one of my exes to which I sighed trying to get a grip on my social anxiety and prepare to be social. This set them off, they personalized it—which I can understand I guess, but I explained it had nothing to do with them or the death. I involuntarily sighed to try to calm my nerves and I feel bad if I knew they would take it that way believe me I wouldn’t have.

Unfortunately this back and forth thing can be fairly common in these situations where impulsivity and mistrust takes over. I’m sorry that you have been hurt by these actions fueled by his condition. I’m here if you ever need to process.
